name: Non-syndromic Diaphragmatic or Thoracic Malformation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Non-syndromic Diaphragmatic or Thoracic Malformations

criteria.description: Presence of congenital defect in the diaphragm or thoracic wall confirmed by imaging
No associated syndromic features or systemic malformations on clinical and genetic evaluation
Clinical evidence of respiratory distress or compromised pulmonary function in neonatal period
Radiological confirmation by chest X-ray, ultrasound, or MRI showing diaphragmatic or thoracic defect

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital diaphragmatic or thoracic defect confirmed by imaging plus absence of syndromic features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may be used to exclude syndromic causes; diagnosis is primarily clinical and radiological.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically presents with herniation of abdominal contents into thoracic cavity
Includes chest wall asymmetry or absence of ribs

common.notes: Due to pulmonary hypoplasia or compromised lung expansion

common.symptomName: Reduced breath sounds on affected side
searchTerms: decreased breath sounds on one side
less air entry on affected side

common.notes: Due to compromised thoracic space and respiratory effort
searchTerms: poor sucking or swallowing in neonates

occasional.notes: Underdevelopment of lung tissue on affected side
Displacement of mediastinal structures due to herniation
Visible deformity or uneven chest contour

rare.notes: Displacement of heart due to thoracic defect

laboratory: Arterial blood gas showing hypoxemia and respiratory acidosis in severe cases
imaging: Chest X-ray showing diaphragmatic defect and herniation of abdominal contents
MRI for detailed thoracic and diaphragmatic anatomy
genetic: No consistent pathogenic variants identified; genetic testing used to exclude syndromic causes
other: Physical examination revealing thoracic wall deformity and asymmetry

redFlags: Severe neonatal respiratory distress requiring mechanical ventilation
Failure to thrive due to respiratory compromise
references: Orphanet: Non-syndromic diaphragmatic or thoracic malformation - ORPHA:180776
